title: Daguerreotype atelier
html_source:
The daguerreotype process, invented by Louis-Jaques-Mandé Daguerre in the early 1800’s, was the first publicly available photographic process.

An atelier is an artist’s studio or workshop.

Thus Bloom is referring to an early form of darkroom.
